execution.dependencies: Python stdlib; two pinned existing drawing/datum helpers

frozen_cost_reference.U: wood/plywood/Hillman and service/accessory receipts, tools/machining and other unpriced items
frozen_cost_reference.scope: Frozen catalog comparison basket, including200proposed washers and matching nuts; not latest price, product purchase/selection or modeled mass replacement. Quantities unchanged, so prior catalog pack optimization transfers algebraically.

nominal_mass.limits: Saved BREP volumes, 500kg/m3 wood, unchanged nominal metal and service allowance; pads excluded. Not measured weight or a fresh gravity/load vector.

open_gates: Four cleat/post stations: 0.340625-mm nominal bolt-bore/screw gap; no practical tolerance acceptance.
Actual drilling/cutting tools, bits, guide bushings, clamps and fixture travel/retention.
24 worst-case catalog length flags; delivered shank/thread/washer/nut fit for all stacks.
200 current head/nut tool and removal sides remain unverified.
Supplier minimum angle heel dimensions/material and complete joint mechanics.
Current-revision load response; historical response passes do not transfer.
receiver_interval_basis: Preserved saved full-wall scalar intervals + authenticated unchanged receiver/grip/direction recipes; translated onto current axes and current raw-profile datums. No fresh BREP wall query or swept tool check.

receiving_requirements.conditional_next_length_route: Only consider next listed length for a specific stack if existing-length assignment cannot satisfy the dimensional window. Longer stock needs a shorter actual gaged grip/thread-start that allows this nut seat, and its enlarged outward tip/tool/removal envelope needs its own check; neither is inherited from frozen nominal CAD.
criteria: L >= S + w_head + w_nut + h_nut + 2*pitch, with sound full-seat contact and the actual threaded end extending through the nut

The matching nut runs fully to the required washer seat without stopping on body/runout; applicable full-body cap-screw Lgmax <= S+w_head+w_nut is a conservative purchase-window comparison, not a substitute for delivered threading/fillet/washer-fit inspection
Keep two own washers, matching nut, thread pitch and individual bolt identity; no extra washer packing, cut bolt, full-thread substitution, thinner selection or external preload/friction assumed
Record Actual/Disposition at receipt and dry assembly, including bolt length, washer/nut stack, free nut seating, tip protrusion and tool/removal clearance. No actual values filled by this arithmetic
receiving_requirements.preferred_purchase_route: Retain existing lengths and matching Grade5 nuts/USS washers as proposed. Allocate24 flagged stacks individually using measured underhead L, seated receiver/plate thickness S, two washer thicknesses and nut height. Prefer qualifying existing-length bolts at catalog maximum stack before selecting thinner washers. An alternative within-range washer pair must also retain its separate bending/seat/material qualification; the stack inequality alone is dimensional.
receiving_requirements.tool_scope: Reference wrench sizes9/16 and3/4in from merchant bolt pages. Actual socket wall/depth, open-wrench swing and withdrawal swept clearance are not supplied. The computed protrusion is the minimum axial free length inside a closed socket beyond the nut's outboard face, plus unquantified tool allowance.
receiving_requirements.two_tip_threads: Reuse existing geometry scenario's minimum2UNC pitches; this is the project scenario, not a newly asserted universal standard or a preload instruction.
